hero.headline: Partner in practical African growth opportunities
hero.description: Invest through structured opportunities across gold aggregation, commercial goat farming, and horticulture agribusiness, with documented operating plans, partner reporting, and clear onboarding.

opportunities.headline: More than gold investing
opportunities.description: The opportunity pipeline now extends from precious-metal aggregation into food security and export-oriented agribusiness. Each route is handled as a separate investment discussion with its own operating model, capital use, and due diligence pack.

items.title: Busia gold aggregation
items.description: Working capital for documented gold sourcing, aggregation, processing support, and compliant onward sale through the Busia operating network.
items.capital_use: Purchase liquidity, aggregation logistics, testing, refining coordination, and transaction documentation.
items.investor_fit: Investors seeking a shorter-cycle opportunity linked to AfriGold Hub's existing gold value chain.
highlights: Built around documented purchase and sale records
Can be paired with the existing gold investment tier structure
Designed for frequent reporting and disciplined capital rotation

items.title: Commercial goat farming
items.description: A livestock investment route focused on breeding, fattening, veterinary controls, feed systems, and structured market offtake.
items.capital_use: Breeding stock, housing, feed, veterinary programs, labor, water systems, and market preparation.
items.investor_fit: Partners looking for an asset-backed agribusiness opportunity with a staged production cycle.
highlights: Focus on herd growth, animal health, and sale readiness
Suitable for phased deployment and operating milestones
Supports rural employment and local protein supply

items.title: Horticulture agribusiness
items.description: A crop-production opportunity covering land preparation, irrigation, inputs, harvest handling, and buyer-linked distribution.
items.capital_use: Irrigation, seed and seedlings, soil preparation, crop protection, labor, harvest handling, and route-to-market logistics.
items.investor_fit: Investors interested in food production, export potential, and recurring agricultural cycles.
highlights: Structured around crop calendars and measurable field milestones
Emphasis on irrigation, input control, and harvest quality
Designed to serve local and regional food demand

tiers.headline: Gold aggregation partner tiers
tiers.description: These tiers apply to the gold aggregation opportunity. Agribusiness opportunities are scoped separately after the first enquiry and due diligence review.

items.label: Seed Partner
features: 5% equity stake in monthly net profits

items.label: Strategic Partner
features: 18% equity stake in monthly net profits

process.headline: From enquiry to monthly distributions
process.description: A clear partner onboarding path keeps the investment process documented, reviewable, and predictable.

items.title: Submit your interest
items.description: Choose a tier or request the due diligence pack so our investment team can qualify your enquiry.

items.title: Review documents
items.description: Receive licence copies, audited monthly statements, assay examples, sales receipts, and the partner agreement.

items.title: Execute agreement
items.description: Complete KYC, sign the investment agreement, and fund through the agreed bank transfer route.

items.title: Track monthly performance
items.description: Receive monthly reports and distributions based on verified net profit and your contracted equity share.

items.title: Formal investment agreement
items.description: Every tier is governed by a written partnership agreement covering equity share, reporting, term, exit, and distribution terms.

items.title: Monthly evidence pack
items.description: Partners receive production records, sale receipts, assay certificates, P&L summaries, and distribution calculations.

items.title: Site access by tier
items.description: Strategic and Anchor partners receive priority site access with operations leadership and finance review sessions.

items.title: Auditable value chain
items.description: Chain-of-custody documentation follows gold from pit weight ticket through sale and investor distribution.
